L0H0_ATTN.hypothesis: L0H0 reads from multiple positions with content-dependent (non-purely-positional) spread attention (mean max=0.494), so it aggregates across positions rather than routing by index; ablating it leaves predictions unchanged but changes downstream MLP writes.

L0_MLP.hypothesis: L0_MLP fuses the token-at-position signal with L0H0_ATTN's write (two distinct upstream sources); ablating L0_MLP breaks predictions and causes large changes in L1_MLP and L2_MLP writes.

L1_MLP.hypothesis: L1_MLP fuses the token-at-position signal with L0_MLP's write (two distinct upstream sources); ablating L1_MLP partially breaks predictions and causes large changes in L2_MLP write (max=14.93 vs norm=30.68).

L2_MLP.hypothesis: L2_MLP fuses the token-at-position signal with L1_MLP's write (two distinct upstream sources); ablating it leaves predictions unchanged but causes large changes in L3H0_ATTN writes (max=35.11), confirming it contributes values copied by the router.

L3H0_ATTN.hypothesis: L3H0 attends with probability 1.0 to the mirror position (pos i attends to pos 10-i) based solely on position, copying content from that position to implement reversal; ablating it completely destroys predictions.
